caseNameFull: Georgia v. Ashcroft, Attorney General, Et Al.

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. D. C. Probable jurisdiction noted. Brief of appellant is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, March 3, 2003. Brief of appellees is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Wednesday, April 2, 2003. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, April 21, *1152 2003. This Court’s Rule 29.2 does not apply.
